name: Pomodoro
summary: A focus and break timer in the notch
description: Pick Focus or Break, set any length from a minute to eight hours and start the timer from the notch, or start a stopwatch. The time runs beside the notch with a progress ring, on the lock screen and on a Home widget that also shows on your iPhone. When a session ends it sounds, shows a notice and counts overtime until you start the next one. Play brown, pink or white noise while you focus.
author: Sumit
